scripts.test: npm run build && node --test build/tests/unit/*.test.js build/tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 HTML_PPT_NETWORK_TESTS=1 node --test build/tests/browser/*.test.js build/tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.deck:build: npm run build --silent && node build/src/cli.js build
scripts.deck:preview: npm run build --silent && node build/src/cli.js preview
scripts.deck:export: npm run build --silent && node build/src/cli.js export
scripts.deck:check: npm run build --silent && node build/src/cli.js check
scripts.check:themes: npm run build --silent && node build/src/cli.js check-themes
